run_select_successful_tests: run the CLI to select successful test translations and write BPE files for multiple languages
run_get_first_success: run get_first_success to find the shortest successful translation from beam search results for a language
run_select_tests_several_asserts: run select_tests_several_asserts to filter test results keeping only tests with multiple assert statements
run_write_bpe_files: run write_bpe_files to apply BPE encoding and write parallel language pairs to training files
run_main_pipeline: run the main pipeline to process test results CSVs, extract successful translations, and generate BPE training data
